svg.title: Dense and foveated stereo token density
svg.desc: Three representative image grids compare the model's 16 by 16 image tokens, a 64 by 48 grid matching the fovea's effective token density, and three centered 16 by 16 pyramid levels at 400 by 400, 1000 by 800, and 1600 by 1200 pixels. Counts beneath each grid include both stereo images.
